in_marathi.name: Drupada
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Drupada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Drupada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Drupada was a king of the Pandava dynasty. His name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dru’, meaning 'tree' or 'lord'. He is the father of the legendary Pandava brothers, including Bhima and Arjuna.
